A quick, very cheap, easy-to-undo and safe way of making the iPhone 4 work with the TomTom car kit / mount from the 3G/3GS.

All it takes is a tiny strip of foam rubber about 2mm thick and the iPhone 4 fits into the mount perfectly. If you don't add something like this, then the phone fits vertically, but it will not be charged as it is a little "thinner" and doesn't trip the power connection on the back of the base of the mount.

blogged: iPhone 4 and the accessories conundrum - http://wp.me/pGVI-q6

This video shows code written by Ciro Cattuto running on the ESP32-C3FH4-RGB NeoPixel board as a standalone device (independent from a PC).
